simple.meaning: לְמוֹ (lᵉmôw) is a Hebrew object word meaning “to or for.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H3926. lemo לְמוֺ in poetry for לְ (see מוֺ ) Job 27:14 ; 29:21 ; 38:40 ; 40:4 . לְמוֺ in poetry for לְ , Job 27:14 ; 29:21 ; 38:40 ; 40:4 , like כְּמוֺ for בְמוֺ כְּ, for ׃בְּ see מוֺ . לְמוֺ in poetry for לְ .
